findings.title: Expected resolved key is checked only after whole-file body consumption
findings.deductive_witness: resolve A; open bounded regular B; fd native B; read B; caller rejects A versus B only after whole_file returns
findings.required_delta: whole_file accepts expected; stable(expected,before) immediately after native(fd), before any os.read; caller passes before.stat; retain after and caller checks

informational_limits: Directory membership is path-bracketed/two-pass names, not same-fd; the current contract does not promise the latter.
O_NOFOLLOW is terminal-component only; discrete observations are not namespace-race exclusion.
The ordinary trusted observer bootstrap is an explicit accepted assumption, not recursive self-attestation.
